page.title: 進行形の不満から現在完了へ

analysis.summaryJa: always・constantly・foreverと進行形を組み合わせると、単なる頻度ではなく話し手の不満・驚き・親しみなどの感情を帯びた反復を表せる。一方、現在完了have/has + 過去分詞は、過去の出来事や状態を現在の視点へ引き寄せ、完了・現在結果を表す。疑問文ではhave/hasを主語の前へ、否定文ではnotを後ろへ置く。
grammarPoints: always/constantly/forever + 進行形は感情を帯びた反復を表せる
現在完了はhave/has + 過去分詞で作る
現在完了は過去の出来事の現在結果・完了を表す
現在完了の疑問文はHave/Has + 主語 + 過去分詞
現在完了の否定文はhave/has not + 過去分詞
visualEvidence: ALWAYSの反復ループが感情を帯びた繰り返しを示している
HAVEの矢印が過去からNOWへ伸び現在完了の視点を示している
have/hasが主語の前へ移動する図が疑問文の構造を示している
notがhave/hasの直後に入る図が否定形を示している
commonTraps: always + 進行形を中立的頻度と同じに扱う
現在完了を明確な過去時点と一緒に使う
hasの後ろを過去形にする
現在完了疑問文でdo/doesを使う

questions.prompt: Mr. Cole is always ------- his access card at home.
questions.translationJa: コールさんはいつもアクセスカードを家に置き忘れてばかりいます。
questions.explanationJa: is always leavingは、繰り返しに対する不満や呆れを帯びた進行形です。

questions.prompt: We ------- the revised contract, so it is ready for the client.
questions.translationJa: 改訂契約書を完成させたので、顧客に渡せる状態です。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の完了が現在のreadyという結果につながるためhave completedが適切です。

questions.prompt: The supplier has ------- the wrong item again.
questions.translationJa: 仕入先はまた間違った商品を送ってきました。
questions.explanationJa: hasの後ろには過去分詞sentを置きます。

questions.prompt: Have you ------- the travel expense report yet?
questions.translationJa: 出張経費報告書はもう仕上げましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了疑問文はHave + 主語 + 過去分詞finishedです。

questions.prompt: The printer is constantly ------- during busy periods.
questions.translationJa: そのプリンターは繁忙時にしょっちゅう紙詰まりを起こしてばかりいます。
questions.explanationJa: is constantly jammingは反復への不満を帯びた表現です。

questions.prompt: She has ------- her security badge, so she cannot enter the office.
questions.translationJa: 彼女はセキュリティバッジをなくしてしまったので、オフィスに入れません。
questions.explanationJa: 紛失という過去の出来事の結果が現在も続いているためhas lostです。

questions.prompt: I haven’t ------- the client’s final approval yet.
questions.translationJa: 顧客の最終承認をまだ受け取っていません。
questions.explanationJa: haven'tの後ろには過去分詞receivedを置きます。

questions.prompt: Our neighbor office is forever ------- packages at our reception desk by mistake.
questions.translationJa: 隣のオフィスはいつも間違って荷物をこちらの受付に届けてばかりいます。
questions.explanationJa: is forever deliveringは繰り返しへの感情を強く表します。

questions.prompt: Has the maintenance team ------- the elevator repair?
questions.translationJa: 保守チームはエレベーター修理を完了しましたか。
questions.explanationJa: Has + 主語 + 過去分詞completedが現在完了疑問文です。

questions.prompt: The director has ------- the budget, and accounting can now proceed.
questions.translationJa: 部長が予算を承認したので、経理は今処理を進められます。
questions.explanationJa: 承認済みという現在結果を表すためhas approvedが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence expressing irritation about repeated behavior.

choices.A: He always leaves his mug here as a neutral timetable.
choices.B: He has always leaving his mug on my desk.
choices.C: He is always leave his mug on my desk.
choices.D: He is always leaving his mug on my desk.

questions.translationJa: 彼はいつも私の机にマグカップを置きっぱなしにしてばかりいます。
questions.explanationJa: is always leavingは繰り返しへの不満を帯びます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct present perfect sentence.
questions.translationJa: 私たちは草案を完成させました。
questions.explanationJa: 複数主語weにはhave + 過去分詞finishedを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct present perfect question.

choices.A: Do you have finished the report?
choices.B: Did you have finished the report?

questions.translationJa: 報告書は仕上げましたか。
questions.explanationJa: have/has自体が助動詞なので疑問文ではHaveを主語の前へ出します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct negative present perfect sentence.

choices.A: She hasn't received the invoice yet.
choices.B: She doesn't received the invoice yet.
choices.C: She hasn't receive the invoice yet.
choices.D: She isn't received the invoice yet.

questions.translationJa: 彼女はまだ請求書を受け取っていません。
questions.explanationJa: has not + 過去分詞receivedが正しい形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence showing a present result of a past event.

choices.A: Mr. Lee is lost his key, so he cannot open the cabinet.
choices.B: Mr. Lee lost his key in 2019, so this sentence must be present perfect.
choices.C: Mr. Lee has lose his key, so he cannot open the cabinet.
choices.D: Mr. Lee has lost his key, so he cannot open the cabinet.

questions.translationJa: リーさんは鍵をなくしてしまったので、キャビネットを開けられません。
questions.explanationJa: 紛失の結果が今のcannot openにつながっているためhas lostが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence expressing repeated behavior with emotional coloring.

choices.A: The system has constantly sending duplicate alerts.
choices.B: The system constantly is send duplicate alerts.
choices.C: The system is constantly sending duplicate alerts.
choices.D: The system is constantly sent duplicate alerts.

questions.translationJa: そのシステムは重複通知をしょっちゅう送り続けています。
questions.explanationJa: is constantly sendingは繰り返しへの苛立ちなどを表せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a completed task with relevance now.

choices.A: The team has install the update, so the system is ready.
choices.B: The team has installed the update, so the system is ready.
choices.C: The team did has installed the update, so the system is ready.
choices.D: The team is installed the update, so the system is ready.

questions.translationJa: チームが更新をインストールしたので、システムは使用可能です。
questions.explanationJa: 完了した作業の現在結果をhas installedで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct present perfect question for a singular subject.

choices.A: Has Ms. Ito submit the form?
choices.B: Have Ms. Ito submitted the form?
choices.C: Does Ms. Ito has submitted the form?
choices.D: Has Ms. Ito submitted the form?

questions.translationJa: 伊藤さんはフォームを提出しましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 三人称単数主語にはHas + 主語 + 過去分詞submittedを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the natural complaint about repeated changes.

choices.A: You have always changing the meeting time.
choices.B: You always are change the meeting time.
choices.C: You are always changing the meeting time.
choices.D: You are always changed the meeting time.

questions.translationJa: あなたはいつも会議時間を変えてばかりですね。
questions.explanationJa: are always changingは繰り返しへの不満を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct statement about present perfect form.

choices.A: Have/has behaves as an auxiliary for questions and negatives.
choices.B: Present perfect questions always require do/does.
choices.C: The lexical verb after have/has stays in base form.
choices.D: Present perfect cannot express a present result.

questions.translationJa: have/hasは疑問文や否定文を作る助動詞として働きます。
questions.explanationJa: have/hasが文法操作を担い、後ろには過去分詞を置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “She is always interrupting me.”

choices.A: The speaker presents her repeated interruptions with emotional coloring.
choices.B: The sentence neutrally lists a scheduled interruption time.
choices.C: She interrupted only once in the distant past.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は彼女の繰り返す割り込みを感情を込めて述べています。
questions.explanationJa: always + 進行形は単なる頻度以上の感情を帯びます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I’ve completed the first draft.”

choices.A: The draft is still certainly untouched.
choices.B: I completed it only at a specified time in 2010.
choices.C: I am merely planning to start it.
choices.D: The first draft is complete now as a result of my earlier work.

questions.translationJa: 以前の作業の結果、今は第1稿が完成しています。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了は過去の完了を現在の視点に結びつけます。
questions.focus: 現在完了の完了・結果

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “She has broken her glasses.”

choices.A: She is planning to buy glasses tomorrow.
choices.B: She broke them at a specified time in 2005 and current state is irrelevant.
choices.C: Her glasses are now in a broken state because of a past event.
choices.D: Her glasses have never been damaged.

questions.translationJa: 過去の出来事の結果、眼鏡は今壊れた状態です。
questions.explanationJa: has brokenは現在に残る結果を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Have you finished?”

choices.A: The speaker asks what time you finished in 1999.
choices.B: The speaker asks whether completion has been reached by now.
choices.C: The speaker predicts you will start tomorrow.
choices.D: The speaker states you have not begun.

questions.translationJa: 今までに完了したかどうかを尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了疑問文は現在時点までの完了を確認します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I haven’t received the package yet.”

choices.A: Up to now, the package has not arrived for me.
choices.B: I received it at a definite time yesterday.
choices.C: The package can never arrive in the future.
choices.D: I am currently sending the package.

questions.translationJa: 今の時点まで、その荷物を受け取っていません。
questions.explanationJa: haven't received yetは現在までの未完了を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The printer is constantly jamming.”

choices.A: The printer jammed only once yesterday.
choices.B: The printer jams once a year on a neutral schedule only.
choices.C: The repeated jams are presented with annoyance or emphasis.

questions.translationJa: 繰り返す紙詰まりを、苛立ちや強調を込めて述べています。
questions.explanationJa: constantly + 進行形は感情を帯びた反復を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The manager has approved the budget.”

choices.A: The budget approval will begin next year.
choices.B: The manager approved it only at a specified date that must be stated.
choices.C: The manager is refusing to review it.
choices.D: The approval is complete and relevant to the current situation.

questions.translationJa: 承認は完了しており、その結果が現在の状況に関係しています。
questions.explanationJa: has approvedは完了済みの現在関連性を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Has the courier arrived?”

choices.A: The speaker asks whether the courier has reached here by now.
choices.B: The speaker asks the exact time of a completed arrival last year.
choices.C: The speaker states the courier will never arrive.
choices.D: The speaker asks about a habitual route only.

questions.translationJa: 配達員が今までに到着したかを尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: Has...arrived?は現在時点での到着済みかどうかを問います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “You’re forever changing the plan.”

choices.A: The plan changes once on a fixed annual timetable.
choices.B: The speaker reacts emotionally to repeated plan changes.
choices.C: The plan was changed only in the past.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は繰り返される計画変更に感情的に反応しています。
questions.explanationJa: forever + 進行形は反復への不満・驚きなどを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Present perfect brings the past into the present viewpoint.”

choices.A: Present perfect describes only future plans.
choices.B: Every past event must use present perfect even with yesterday.
choices.C: A past event or state is viewed in terms of its relevance or result now.
choices.D: Present perfect has no connection to current perspective.

questions.translationJa: 過去の出来事や状態を、今との関連や結果という視点で捉えます。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了の中心概念を正しく言い換えています。

questions.prompt: The office manager sounds annoyed. “He is always ------- the meeting room unlocked.”
questions.translationJa: オフィスマネージャーは苛立っています。『彼はいつも会議室を施錠せずにしてばかりです』。
questions.explanationJa: is always leavingが繰り返しへの不満を表します。

questions.prompt: The report is ready to send because the analyst ------- all the figures.
questions.translationJa: 分析担当者がすべての数値を確認済みなので、報告書は送信可能です。
questions.explanationJa: 確認完了の現在結果readyに結びつくためhas checkedです。

questions.prompt: The client is waiting for confirmation. “------- you received our revised quotation yet?”
questions.translationJa: 顧客は確認を待っています。『改訂見積書はもう受け取りましたか』。
questions.explanationJa: 現在までの受領を問うためHave you received...?を使います。

questions.prompt: The replacement part has not arrived. We ------- it yet, so the repair cannot begin.
questions.translationJa: 交換部品は到着していません。まだ受け取っていないため、修理を開始できません。
questions.explanationJa: 現在までの未受領はhaven't received yetで表します。

questions.prompt: The supervisor complains about repeated errors: “The system is constantly ------- customer names incorrectly.”
questions.translationJa: 上司は繰り返すミスに不満を言います。『システムは顧客名をしょっちゅう間違って綴っています』。
questions.explanationJa: is constantly spellingは繰り返しへの不満を帯びます。

questions.prompt: The door will not open because Ms. Sato ------- her access card.
questions.translationJa: 佐藤さんがアクセスカードをなくしてしまったため、ドアが開きません。
questions.explanationJa: 紛失の結果が現在のドアを開けられない状況につながるためhas lostです。

questions.prompt: The director asks for an update. “Has the legal team ------- the agreement?”
questions.translationJa: 部長が進捗を尋ねます。『法務チームは契約書を確認しましたか』。
questions.explanationJa: Has + 主語 + 過去分詞reviewedが正しい現在完了疑問文です。

questions.prompt: The assistant says with frustration, “You’re always ------- the shared calendar without telling anyone.”
questions.translationJa: アシスタントは苛立って『誰にも言わず共有カレンダーをいつも変更してばかりですね』と言います。
questions.explanationJa: are always changingが不満を込めた反復を表します。

questions.prompt: The installation is complete, and the machine is operating normally. The technicians ------- the new software successfully.
questions.translationJa: インストールは完了し、機械は正常稼働しています。技術者は新ソフトを正常に導入しました。
questions.explanationJa: 導入完了の結果が現在の正常稼働につながるためhave installedです。

questions.prompt: The customer still has no confirmation email. “I’m sorry, but we ------- the message yet.”
questions.translationJa: 顧客にはまだ確認メールがありません。『申し訳ありませんが、まだメッセージを送っていません』。
questions.explanationJa: 現在まで未送信という状況なのでhaven't sent yetが適切です。
